satisfiable.head: : ∃ (Z : Zeta23.ZeroConfig) (rhs : (ℝ → ℂ) → ℂ), EpsteinPremises Z rhs ∧ rhoE ∈ Z.carrier

load_bearing.head: : ∃ (Z : Zeta23.ZeroConfig) (rhs : (ℝ → ℂ) → ℂ) (hP : EpsteinPremises Z rhs), h2_sign_cfg (epsteinConfig Z rhs hP)

conclusion.head: (Z : Zeta23.ZeroConfig) (rhs : (ℝ → ℂ) → ℂ) (hP : EpsteinPremises Z rhs) (hE : rhoE ∈ Z.carrier) : ¬ h2_sign_cfg (epsteinConfig Z rhs hP)

check:
SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.epstein_not_h2_sign_cfg : ∀ (Z : Zeta23.ZeroConfig) (rhs : (ℝ → ℂ) → ℂ)
  (hP : SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.EpsteinPremises Z rhs),
  SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.rhoE ∈ Z.carrier →
    ¬SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.h2_sign_cfg (SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.epsteinConfig Z rhs hP)
